passage: When the archaeologists finally opened the sealed chamber in 1922, they discovered that the ancient builders ______ the walls with a mixture of lime and crushed shells to keep out moisture.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The discovery happened in 1922; the lining happened earlier still.
An action before another past action takes the past perfect: “had lined.”
Future, present progressive and simple present don't fit the timeline.
